exec git init -b main
at 2026-09-07T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix ready-
exec card config set --scope store issue.id.strategy sequential

exec card create --priority 1 'Claimable work'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/claimable.txt
exec card create --priority 0 'Waiting work'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/waiting.txt
exec card --actor worker claim ready-2
exec card --actor worker release ready-2 --waiting 'independent acceptance'

# The ready view keeps waiting work visible with its reason.
exec card ready
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/all.txt

# Callers may request the strictly claimable pool.
exec card ready --no-waiting
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/claimable-only.txt

-- golden/claimable.txt --
ready-1
-- golden/waiting.txt --
ready-2
-- golden/all.txt --
ID       PRI  STATUS   TYPE  TITLE           WAITING FOR
ready-1  1    ready    task  Claimable work  -
ready-2  0    waiting  task  Waiting work    independent acceptance
-- golden/claimable-only.txt --
ID       PRI  STATUS  TYPE  TITLE
ready-1  1    ready   task  Claimable work
